  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(List<Player> players)
      Initializes a new Game instance with the provided list of players.

      It sets up the game board based on the number of players, initializes the time trackers (round and era), and sets the initial state to the Setup phase.

      Parameters:
      players - The list of players joining the game. Must contain between 2 and 5 players.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the player list is null or has an invalid size.

  • Method Details

    • startGame

      public void startGame()
      Orchestrates the initialization of the game world and prepares the board for the first round.

      This method performs the following setup sequence:

      • Initializes game components (Offer Tiles and Turn Order Track) based on the player count.
      • Shuffles player order and assigns initial food resources according to the turn position.
      • Populates the Lower Row with tribe cards, filtering out event cards to the Upper Row.
      • Fills the Upper Row with the required number of cards and Era I building cards.
      • Triggers the initial game state execution to begin the match.

    • changeState

      public void changeState(GameStateLogic newState)
      Handles the transition of the game from one phase to another.

      This method is typically called by the states themselves when they have completed their tasks and need to pass control to the next state.

      Parameters:
      newState - The new state the game should transition to.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided state is null.

    • checkNicknameUnique

      public boolean checkNicknameUnique(String name)
      Checks if a chosen nickname is unique among the current players.

      This method is useful during the lobby or login phase to prevent players from choosing duplicate names. The comparison is case-insensitive.

      Parameters:
      name - The nickname to check.
      Returns:
      true if the nickname is available, false if it is already taken or invalid.

    • placeTotemOnOffer

      public void placeTotemOnOffer(Player p, OfferTile t)
      Attempts to place a player's totem on a specific offer tile.

      Following the State Pattern, the Game class does not handle the logic directly. Instead, it delegates the action to the current state. The active state will decide whether to execute the placement, ignore it, or throw an exception depending on the current phase of the round.

      Parameters:
      p - The player attempting to place the totem.
      t - The offer tile chosen by the player.

    • handleEraTransition

      public void handleEraTransition(Era nextEra)
      Handles the transition to the next Era following the official rulebook.

      Step 1: At the start of Era III, discard Buildings from the lower row. Step 2: Move Buildings from the upper row to the lower row. Step 3: Place the new Era's Building cards in the upper row.

      Parameters:
      nextEra - The card's era that triggered the era transition.

    • notifyBuildingEffects

      public void notifyBuildingEffects(TriggerType trigger)
      Notifies all building effects in the game that a specific trigger has occurred. This method iterates over every player and over every building owned in their tribe. For each building that has an associated BuildingEffect, the effect is executed through the Strategy Pattern by invoking applyEffect(Player, Game, TriggerType).

    • notifyPlayersBuildingEffects

      public void notifyPlayersBuildingEffects(TriggerType trigger, Player player)
      Notifies all player's building effects in the game that a specific trigger has occurred. This method iterates over every building owned in their tribe. For each building that has an associated BuildingEffect, the effect is executed through the Strategy Pattern by invoking applyEffect(Player, Game, TriggerType).
